title: Numeric Experience Info
description: This is a simple Fabric mod that adds text (on the experience bar), showing how many experience points in total you need to reach the next level (and more info).
body:
**⚠️IMPORTANT⚠️**

This mod requires [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).

<hr>

**Mod Description**

**Numeric Experience Info** is client-sided Minecraft mod for the **Fabric Loader**, that adds a text element (directly on top of the experience bar), showing the player how many experience orbs they have collected (per level), and how many they need in total, to level up to the next level. This mod can be toggled with this client-sided command this mod adds: **/toggleexperienceinfo**.

For a visual of this mod, please play the **Mod Demonstration Video** below, or see this mod's screen shots in the **[Gallery Tab](https://modrinth.com/mod/numeric-experience-info/gallery)**.
